messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone!

The R group will be meeting this Friday, in Stone Building room 3203 (or Zoom: https://fsu.zoom.us/j/98450885843<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fj%2F98450885843&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C64c7389d42cb4dea18d608dc648cbaa4%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638495802783425776%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=OoxwfAcR3Zb4ae6zdJVM7G4zKGEySoLkSfWyDdvhf8o%3D&reserved=0>) at noon. This week, we will be working to get the FSU Thesis/Dissertation LaTeX template running in R markdown/quarto.

If you want to learn how to save yourself some time on the manuscript clearance side of the thesis and dissertation process, please come join us!

If you need access to the R group canvas site, you can join here:

https://canvas.fsu.edu/enroll/AWFYCW<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcanvas.fsu.edu%2Fenroll%2FAWFYCW&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C64c7389d42cb4dea18d608dc648cbaa4%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638495802783582144%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=13KsiM1g5VUtJ4zyEwvFI7Aq97cML00ygnJjIA4dZdE%3D&reserved=0>

Hope to see many of you this Friday!




Kari Roberts
